Overview
SAP Engagement Cloud connects real-time insights with operations to enable personalized, AI-driven engagement across channels, turning interactions into experiences that build trust and drive growth.
Acquire new customers and drive the first purchase
Accelerate time to value and streamline omnichannel campaign execution with AI-enhanced tools for cross-channel content creation and orchestration.
Create new revenue streams by activating external events and enterprise data - such as order and inventory updates, service tickets, and loyalty milestones - to orchestrate revenue-driving interactions across every channel.
Use customer data to personalize advertising across display, search, and social channels. Automate digital advertising campaigns to engage contacts in real time and embed a lead form to grow your audience.
Understand which audiences to target by providing comparative metrics on custom segments, then analyze results and responses and refine your segments based on data-rich insights.
Accelerate time to value and streamline omnichannel campaign execution with AI-enhanced tools for cross-channel content creation and orchestration.
